image_description: A grey whale tail fluke emerging vertically from the ocean surface, displaying a dark grey to black coloration with mottled white patches and barnacle encrustations. The fluke shows a smooth trailing edge with a distinct central notch. The surrounding water is blue-grey with gentle ripples and foam at the base of the tail.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is completely submerged and not visible in the frame; only the tail fluke is shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible on the tail fluke surface: clear mottling pattern with lighter patches consistent with barnacle/lice encrustations typical of grey whales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal region/knuckles are not visible as only the tail fluke emerges from water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the tail section is visible; the main body is submerged and cannot be assessed for shape or proportion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Clearly visible on the fluke surface - characteristic grey whale skin texture with barnacle patterns.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Baleen plates are inside the mouth and not visible when the whale is diving with only tail exposed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are not visible in this tail-fluke-only view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Perfectly matches: broad flukes, smooth trailing edge, and clear central notch visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Surface texture appears appropriately rough with visible callosity-like bumps and barnacle attachments.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/blurring at the very edges of the fluke where it meets the sky background, possibly indicating minor edge bleeding or AI-generated smoothing.
The foam/water interaction at the base of the tail appears slightly unnatural - the splash pattern lacks realistic turbulence detail expected from such a large mass emerging.
